canonical: AGG SUM(amount) ON orders GROUP BY [region] AS totalamount
AGG COUNT(*) ON orders GROUP BY [region] AS row_count
AGG MEAN(score) ON clicks GROUP BY [channel] AS avg_score
AGG MAX(amount) ON orders GROUP BY [region] AS max_amount
AGG SUM(amount) ON orders GROUP BY [region] AS sum_amount
WINDOW SUM(amount) ON orders PARTITION BY [region] ORDER BY ts RANGE BETWEEN -2 AND 1 MAX_ROWS 4 AS rolling_sum
WINDOW ROW_NUMBER(*) ON clicks PARTITION BY [channel] ORDER BY ts RANGE BETWEEN -100 AND 0 MAX_ROWS 100 AS rn
WINDOW SUM(score) ON clicks PARTITION BY [channel] ORDER BY ts RANGE BETWEEN -1 AND 0 MAX_ROWS 10 AS sum_score
